content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026 Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 must possess the required educational qualifications for their respective posts. The eligibility requirements vary depending on the position. Superintendent: First Class Bachelor's Degree or equivalent from a recognized University or Institute in any discipline OR Master's Degree in any discipline from a recognized University or Institute with at least 50% marks or equivalent grade. Knowledge of computer applications, including word processing and spreadsheets, is required. Technical Assistant: First Class Bachelor's Degree, Master's Degree, or Diploma in the relevant discipline as per the specific department requirements mentioned in the notification. Senior Assistant: Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board with a minimum typing speed of 35 words per minute and proficiency in computer word processing and spreadsheets. Senior Technician: Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science, including Chemistry as one of the subjects, from a government-recognized board with at least 60% marks. Technician: Senior Secondary (10+2) with Science, ITI, or Diploma in Engineering from a government-recognized Polytechnic, Institute, or Board, depending on the specific department requirements. Office Attendant: Senior Secondary (10+2) from a recognized board. Important: As clarified in the official extension notice, candidates must satisfy the prescribed qualifications, experience, and other eligibility criteria as on 30 October 2026 . The extension of the application deadline does not change this cut-off date.

content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026 Application Fee
content_sections.text: Candidates applying for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty vacancies are required to pay the application fee according to their category.

content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026 Age Limit
content_sections.text: The maximum age limit for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 varies from 27 to 33 years depending on the post. The age limit will be calculated as on 30 October 2026 , which remains the official eligibility cut-off date. Age Relaxation: The following relaxations apply as per the recruitment notification and applicable rules. SC/ST: 5 Years OBC: 3 Years PwBD: 10 Years Departmental Candidates: 5 Years Note: The age eligibility cut-off date remains 30 October 2026 , even though the online application deadline has been extended to 15 November 2026. Candidates should calculate their age based on the unchanged cut-off date. Candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age as on 30 October 2026 before applying.

content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026 Salary
content_sections.text: Selected candidates will receive salaries according to the pay levels prescribed for their respective posts. The post-wise pay levels range from Level 1 to Level 6.

content_sections.heading: NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026 Important Dates
content_sections.text: NIT Raipur has extended the online application deadline for its Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026. Candidates can submit their applications until 15 November 2026, 11:59 PM. However, the eligibility cut-off date remains unchanged. Important Clarification: According to the extension notice issued on 28 October 2026, the deadline for submitting online applications has been extended to 15 November 2026, 23:59 hours. However, the cut-off date for determining age limit, educational qualifications, experience, and other eligibility criteria remains unchanged at 30 October 2026.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility requirements can apply online for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 through the official website. The application deadline has been extended to 15 November 2026 (11:59 PM) . Visit the official website of NIT Raipur at www.nitrr.ac.in . Find the Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 notification and online application link. Read the official notification and extension notice carefully before applying. Check whether you meet the required qualifications, age limit, experience, and other eligibility conditions as on 30 October 2026. Complete the online application form with accurate personal, educational, and contact details. Upload the required photograph, signature, certificates, and other documents in the prescribed format. Pay the applicable application fee through the available online payment method. Review all information carefully before final submission. Submit the online application on or before 15 November 2026, 11:59 PM . Download or print the submitted application form for future reference. Note: Only the application submission deadline has been extended. Candidates must fulfil all prescribed eligibility conditions as on 30 October 2026.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty recruitment?
faq.answer: The National Institute of Technology Raipur (NIT Raipur) is conducting the recruitment process for 37 Non-Faculty positions under advertisement number No./NITRR/R-1/Advt./2026/1035.

faq.question: Q2. How many total vacancies are available in NIT Raipur Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 37 vacancies available for various non-faculty posts including Superintendent, Technical Assistant, Senior Assistant, Senior Technician, Technician, and Office Attendant.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online for NIT Raipur Non-Faculty Recruitment 2026 has been extended to 15 November 2026, up to 11:59 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the application fee for UR/OBC/EWS candidates?
faq.answer: Candidates belonging to the UR, OBC-NCL, and EWS categories are required to pay an application fee of Rs. 2360/-, which includes Rs. 2000 plus 18% GST.

faq.question: Q5. What are the eligible qualifications for these posts?
faq.answer: The qualifications vary by post, ranging from 10th standard, Senior Secondary (10+2), ITI, Diploma, to Bachelor's and Master's Degrees from recognized institutions.

faq.question: Q6. What is the age limit for the Technician post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the Technician post is 27 years. Standard age relaxations are applicable for reserved categories as per government guidelines.

faq.question: Q7. What salary structure is offered for Superintendent and Technical Assistant?
faq.answer: Both Superintendent and Technical Assistant positions fall under Pay Level-6 of the 7th CPC Pay Matrix, ensuring competitive government remuneration.

faq.question: Q8. What is the eligibility cut-off date for NIT Raipur Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The eligibility cut-off date remains 30 October 2026. Age limit, educational qualifications, experience, and other eligibility conditions will be determined as on this date.

faq.question: Q9. What is the selection procedure for these vacancies?
faq.answer: The selection process typically includes a screening test followed by a skill test or typing test wherever applicable depending on the specific non-faculty post requirements.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I check the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the direct links to access the official notification PDF, complete your online application, and visit the official NIT Raipur website in the Important Links section above.
